mainEntity.name: What types of finishes are available for cabinet refinishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: A variety of finishes are available for cabinet refinishing, including opaque paints, transparent stains, and glazes, each offering different aesthetics and durability. Paints provide a solid, uniform color, while stains highlight the wood grain. Glazes can add depth and an aged look. We can discuss various options to help you choose a finish that complements your home's style and stands up to daily use in the East Bay.
